g.text: A local-first research chat. One Node process, local SQLite recall, one model-visible tool.
recall packet: dates, past turns, sources
SSE events as the turn runs:
What leaves this machine: recent messages, bounded
recalled context and source excerpts go to the configured
LLM; search queries go to Tavily. Everything else stays
The citation check is mechanical and bounded: it
looks for markers, numbers and dates in the cited
excerpt. It does not prove that a source
Request admission is browser-origin protection only. It
does not authenticate local processes or other OS users.
Non-API requests go to Vite (dev) or dist/ (production).
